rows.question: What is CCF?

flag_off.direct_answer: Which figure should CreditProbe measure? Name one of the governed concepts — exposure at default, expected credit loss, internal rating, days past due — and it will compose the analysis.

flag_on.direct_answer: Credit conversion factor. The proportion of an undrawn commitment assumed to be drawn by the time a borrower defaults. It is what turns a limit into an exposure at default: EAD is the drawn balance plus the CCF applied to the undrawn part. Exposure and EAD are therefore different numbers, and this demo keeps them in separate fields.
